newsitem.title: USA: HFS, PHH Corp enter $1.7 bln merger.
newsitem.headline: HFS, PHH Corp enter $1.7 bln merger.

text.p: HFS Inc and PHH Corp said Monday they would merge in a $1.7 billion deal that values each share of PHH at $49.50.
PHH shares closed Friday at 30-3/4. HFS shares closed at 74-1/8.
HFS said it expects a one-time charge from the merger, which is to close in the first quarter 1997. The company said it has not yet estimated the amount of the charge.

HFS said it would issue about 23.2 million common shares in exchange for all outstanding PHH shares in the deal. The maximum number of shares would be 28.7 million and the minimum would be 21.3 million, based on an average HFS share price of between $60 and $81 for the 20 trading days ending five days before the PHH shareholders' vote on the transaction, HFS said.
The deal would be accounted as a pooling of interests and tax-free for PHH shareholders, HFS said.
Upon closing, PHH Chief Executive Robert Kunisch would join the HFS board.
HFS said the merger with PHH would provide it with fleet operating and overhead efficiences for its car rental business and benefit its real estate business.

Besides owning Avis Inc, HFS franchises hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices. PHH's business, which brought net revenues of about $600 million in the year ending July 1996, delivers outsourcing in areas that include vehicle leasing and maintenance, real estate, mortgage banking and insurance services, HFS said.
